title: Share with access to electricity vs. per capita energy use
subtitle: Having access to electricity means having an electricity source that can provide very basic lighting, and charge a phone or power a radio for 4 hours per day. Energy is measured in [kilowatt-hours](#dod:watt-hours) of [total energy supply](#dod:total-energy-supply) per person.
